html:
Tingatinga is a style of painting that began in Dar es Salaam in 1968, when Edward Saidi Tingatinga started painting animals in bright bicycle enamel on square boards to sell to tourists and expatriates.

His bold, flat pictures of birds, elephants and leopards, with strong outlines and plain backgrounds, sold well, and he taught relatives and friends. He was shot dead by police in 1972, mistaken for a thief, but his followers formed a cooperative.

The style grew busier and more colourful and became one of the best known forms of African popular art, sold across Tanzania and abroad. It belongs to the art of Dar es Salaam in the years of ujamaa.
sum: Tingatinga is a style of painting that began in Dar es Salaam in 1968, when Edward Saidi Tingatinga started painting animals in bright bicycle enamel on square boards to sell to tourists and expatriates.
